inputs.title: Trusted browser-reachable Gateway origin (HTTPS or loopback HTTP)

setupSteps: Create a disposable GitHub OAuth App for acceptance; configure its callback URL exactly as below. This implementation uses the supported web flow with S256 PKCE, not device flow or PAT import.

Provision GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET through host-owned masked entry or a private service environment file. Set config.clientSecret to {source: env, provider: default, id: GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET}; never put the value in config or chat.
Map PUBLIC_BASE_URL to config.publicOrigin. HTTPS is required except for localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1] HTTP. This is the exact origin, without a trailing slash.
Enable the installed plugin and its kernel catalog entry using normal supported OpenClaw configuration, validate config, then restart the disposable Gateway.
Run clawos gatekeeper connect github and open its single-use local start URL privately. No gatekeeper-add configuration wizard or PAT option is claimed.
Introduce only the disposable repository/issue/pull URLs after connection; connected OAuth repo scope never creates ambient grants.
